title: Approval of Authorization to Issue up to $1.081 Billion in Power System
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the Chief Financial Officer
  Approval of Authorization to Issue up to $1.081 Billion in Power System
  Revenue Bonds Under Resolution Nos. 5095 and 5096. The proposed
  Resolutions will authorize issuance of up to $1.081 Billion in fixed-rate,
  tax-exempt Power System Revenue Bonds.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
